lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Premium comfort lounge for departing, transit and arriving passengers. 2,200 ₽ per person per hour, with personal check-in 3,500 ₽. Fast-track check-in and priority security 1,700 ₽.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Left luggage: 380 ₽ per item per day (price list from 01.10.2026).

kids.title: With children
kids.text: Mother and child room on Level 1 of the terminal. For passengers with children under 14 and women in the second half of pregnancy. Free of charge. Enquiries: (34670) 62-222.
